title: A Practical Guide to Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a language model with an external document collection. Retrieval supplies evidence that can be inspected and updated without retraining the generator.

title: A Practical Guide to Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: A useful RAG evaluation separates retrieval quality from answer quality. Recall at K measures whether relevant evidence appears in the top K results, while faithfulness measures whether claims are supported by retrieved context.

title: Reliable Machine Learning Systems
text: Production machine learning systems need observability for latency, errors, data drift, and model quality. Logging inputs, outputs, and component timings makes failures diagnosable.

title: Reliable Machine Learning Systems
text: Data contracts define the schema and quality expectations between producers and consumers. They reduce silent breakage when upstream data changes.

title: Responsible Evaluation of Language Models
text: Automated metrics are useful signals, not complete judgments. Evaluation should include representative test cases, documented limitations, and human review for high-impact decisions.
